decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm’s core business that gained its own page by 2024, it reflects meaningful investment and rising public commitment, which management would be reluctant to reverse.

The comfort insole appears to have lower visible commitment because it remained only mentioned on the website, but as a low-risk complement to the footwear range management can still justify keeping it while expecting adoption to build.

The supportive insole also shows limited public prominence and is easier to cut than core footwear lines, yet management is still somewhat likely to continue it because it fits the firm’s customization and foot-health positioning.
An ergonomic safety shoe series with several models and its own page in both years signals substantial investment and clear public commitment in a core category, making withdrawal unlikely.
The firefighter and rescue boot line moved from a mention to its own page, indicating increasing commitment to a specialized professional segment that management would likely continue backing.

Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship, stayed on the home page, and was supported by a concrete 2024 customer-use result, management has strong reputational and sunk-cost reasons to persist with it.
